document.abstract: On 16 January, Josh Gordon and Mike Strein co-produced a panel discussion on high dynamic range (HDR). This panel consisted of some industry titans, including three SMPTE Fellows, two of whom are Life Fellows. The meeting was held at Microsoft’s facility in Times Square. More than 120 people were in attendance.
